item.tib: zhang zhung dzA phur gser gyi yang zhun sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: zhes pa'i me ri'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs 'di ni gsang gling pas bris pa'o// ces dz+wa dmar 'bar ba'i sgrub gzhung 'di ni/ gsang sngags gling pas rdza stod rin chen spungs pa nas gter du drangs shing / slar gter grogs dbang gi sgron ma dang mchog sprul g.yung drung mthong grol khro dbon yid rgyal sogs kyis bskul ngor shog ser la dag par phab pas/ yi ge pa ni rang slob g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa'o//
